title: Global Shifts and Challenges: Brazil’s Historic Election, Serbia’s Student Movement, and France’s Social Unrest
summary: This episode covers Brazil’s historic presidential election victory by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Serbia’s student-led political upheaval ending years of authoritarian rule, ongoing social unrest in France, and key developments in UK justice and global AI economics. We also highlight Algeria’s military deployment to Niger and pay tribute to actor Walter Koenig.
